note: The velvet chair reads as soft cloth with its tufting and wooden legs; anisotropic highlights stretch into arcs that grow with strength and flatten at roughness 1; the prisms show the checkerboard through them with colour fringes growing at dispersion 2 and 5; the thin films tint the spheres pink, green and cyan; the flakes stay put on the panel through the dolly. Weak points: the anisotropy spheres' shaded halves blend into the grey background, the iridescent tints are faint on the near-white base, and the 1 cm flakes under a 0.3 coat read as coarse static rather than glinting paint. The chair and dispersion frames vary slightly from run to run (#1316), so a later run may not reproduce these hashes.
